justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Consistent balance and mobility improvements in elderly; mechanism (sensorimotor learning) plausible. Effect sizes modest.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 800-1,000 hour training over 4 years; among highest total time investments in allied health.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to chronic pain, movement re-education, and neurological conditions; limited by narrow practitioner base.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Almost no third-party coverage; self-pay only; occasionally covered under integrative health or wellness benefit policies.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Very limited employer demand in clinical settings; primarily private practice and performing arts.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Gentle, non-invasive approach appreciated by chronic pain and elderly populations.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Wellness-oriented clientele (dancers, musicians, chronic pain) routinely pay cash; lives outside the insurance model.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Practitioners charge premium wellness rates, but ceiling is limited by being a relatively obscure modality.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Rare credential (4-year training) with a distinct identity, providing real differentiation in wellness markets.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Highly personality- and skill-driven; cannot easily be delegated to staff, capping the business model at solo practice.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Recognized in arts/wellness niches and some metro markets, but minimal mainstream consumer awareness.
justifications.business.efficiency: 800+ hour, 4-year training program — one of the most time-expensive certifications in rehab.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Viewed skeptically in academic PT/OT; not a recognized credential for promotion or hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Sparse peer-reviewed output; mostly small studies and qualitative work.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Limited curricular fit; might appear briefly in a complementary/integrative health elective.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Evidence base is thin with few high-quality RCTs and modest effect sizes.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never listed as preferred or required in DPT/MOT job postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Massive time investment for minimal academic return — worst-in-class efficiency for faculty paths.
